name: Villager
farewell: Off with you, and keep well.

infos.reply: This is the whole of it. The well, the green, and the road out. We keep to ourselves and the season keeps to us.
The city? I went once. Too many walls and not one of them mine.
Get under something. It is walking about up there and it does not look.
It will do the barley good and nothing else any good at all.
Early for it. The road out will be gone by the morning.
Late to be asking. Whatever it is doing, it is doing it in the dark.
Too warm to stand in and too warm to work in. Take the shade while it is there.
Held, for now. It never holds long.
